about: Benign overlaps reported by tools/verify-dupes.mjs. Every entry needs a reason. An entry that matches nothing makes the tool fail, so delete entries when the overlap is fixed. type 'stmt': key = the sorted ids joined by '|'. type 'pair': key = 'idA|idB' (sorted) for an equation shared by a reserved item and a practice item.
notes: bk-p4 (booklet) and phys-vertical-040 share a scenario (ball thrown up at 20 m/s, maximum height) but no typeset equation, so the tool cannot see it; accepted in the 2026-11-04 audit.

Traps like 2^x + 4 = 0 and shared intermediates appear inside solution steps of several banks; only displayed equations (eq / equations / ltr spans of the statement) are compared, so they are not reported.
